zoe: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1: turning findings into a tight closure sprint. Reply with "+owner ETA" to claim.

zoe: Short root-cause: maintenance-induced routing jitter -> missed cross-region snapshot -> complex partial restore. Recurring pattern: long DNS TTLs + manual restore steps.

harper: I'll own snapshot sanity checks and the missed-window backfill. Plan: nightly manifest parity job + one-off reingest for missed snapshots. ETA quick check 4d, automation 3w.

noah: I'll handle the restore-side tooling: add a --preview flag to the restore CLI that prints steps and estimate costs, plus idempotent apply mode. PR will include sample output. ETA 2w.

ajay: Routing owner here. I'll work on a pre-push canary and a fallback route that triggers if BGP convergence > 30s. Also propose a short-term TTL policy during maintenance (30s). ETA prototype 1w.

maria: Runbook updates: add pre/post maintenance checklist (TTL ramp, manifest parity, KV warm) and a one-page on-call TL;DR. PR incoming. ETA 5d.

incident-bot: Created task INC-2026-522: "DR closure sprint" and scheduled a sync 2026-04-13T16:00Z.

zoe: Game-day plan: control-plane dry-run 2026-04-14, full failover rehearsal 2026-04-21. Confirm availability.

harper: 04-14 dry-run ok; will run manifest job beforehand.

noah: 04-21 tentative but should be fine.

ajay: Both dates OK; will prioritize routing fallback test.

maria: available both dates; will bring runbook TL;DR.

zoe: Final: reply with owner + firm ETA so I can populate the action tracker.

harper: snapshots parity job + backfill plan -> 2026-04-08. +1

noah: restore --preview + idempotent mode PR -> 2026-04-20. +1

ajay: routing canary + TTL policy -> 2026-04-07. +1

maria: runbook merge + TL;DR -> 2026-04-06. +1

zoe: Thanks all  I'll update INC-2026-522 and close this thread after cards are created. If something slips, bump here and we'll escalate to the DR rota. :thumbsup:
